name: Light Peg Studio
description: Place tiny translucent lenses into a dark, recessed board. Draw by hand, translate a photograph, or let selected pegs breathe with light.

assets.credit: Original Afterglow moth drawing, generated by the portable light-peg renderer

compatibility: Modern Safari/WebKit and Chromium with Canvas 2D, pointer events, Image.decode and Blob downloads. No runtime packages, GPU extensions, remote images or fonts are needed.

Pointer strokes interpolate across fast movement. Touch uses the same tools; zoom and Move view make small holes accessible. Arrow keys, Space, Delete and undo shortcuts work with the board focused. Escape releases focus.
Animation starts paused, respects reduced motion, and rests when hidden or offscreen. Manual editing and time scrubbing remain available while paused.
Image conversion is local and supports browser-decodable PNG, JPEG, WebP, GIF and AVIF up to 20 MB / 32 megapixels. An animated image contributes its decoded still frame.
notes: The dark board is a cached array of recessed sockets, with etched coordinates and a restrained instrument frame. Lenses combine a cast shadow, colored rim, translucent body, bright core, highlight and diffused halo. Deterministic variation keeps their brightness slightly uneven.

Paint, remove, flood fill, straight lines and a selection brush share a portable board model. Continuous strokes interpolate between received pointer samples. A gesture is one undo step; forty board snapshots support undo, redo, clear, resolution changes and imported drawings.
Afterglow moth, Midnight garden, Orbital study and Chromatic tide are original parametric drawings. Loading a plate is undoable. The unlit board remains useful as a blank starting point.

Image sampling preserves the source aspect ratio. A weighted nearest-palette quantizer and adjustable error diffusion turn it into real editable pegs; dark or transparent pixels remain empty. No photo is uploaded.

Wave, twinkle and progressive drawing-order illumination affect selected pegs only. Optional color cycling remains separate from stored drawing colors. Export a still at any moment, or save the drawing, selection, order and animation settings together.
reuse: Serve the source ZIP over HTTP and open example.html. The complete board, editing model, cached renderer, original drawings, exporter and integration example are included without dependencies.
Import mount for the complete instrument or use the independent model and createRenderer APIs. Feed your own board or load a version 1 drawing document; see the reuse guide for the schema.

Drawing and animation JSON contain artwork. Lab presets contain appearance and interaction settings. Source export deliberately includes the example drawings rather than private uploaded images or the current visitor artwork.
Use setRunning for visibility and dispose on removal. The renderer clears caches; the UI cancels frames, image jobs, observers and listeners and revokes local object URLs.
